security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Check an archive for code that runs by itself, before you open it.
bundle.longDescription: LookFirst checks zip, tar and 7z archives, folders and single files for code that runs without anyone choosing to run it: Git hooks and settings, VS Code tasks, AI assistant hooks, npm install scripts, programs dressed up as documents, and paths that escape the folder. Nothing is extracted, run, or uploaded.
